[!cgo] skip

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd g
cp ../p.src p.go
logos build .
! stderr .
! logos lint --json-diagnostics .
stderr -count=1 '"rule_id":"correctness::arena_pointer_escape"'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*p\.go"'
! stderr '(?m)^[^{\r\n]'
cd ..

cd l
cp ../p.src p.lgo
logos build .
! stderr .
! logos lint --json-diagnostics .
stderr -count=1 '"rule_id":"correctness::arena_pointer_escape"'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*p\.lgo"'
! stderr '(?m)^[^{\r\n]'

-- g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27
-- l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27
-- l/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"
-- p.src --
package p

import "C"
import "unsafe"

var _ C.int

func Restored(p unsafe.Pointer) unsafe.Pointer {
	address := uintptr(p)
	return unsafe.Pointer(address)
}
